'''Michael Chan''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2001 Livingston tournament]] on 22 December 2001 with Galactic Senate DS Mains and Tatooine Pod Mains, according to Michael Robinson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3208">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-23-manga-12-22-return-of-daltond3208/ manga-12-22-return-of-dalton], DeckTech (Michael "Bobafett465" Robinson, 23 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-23-manga-12-22-return-of-daltond3208/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
